$comment: vNext AI page translation — pinned ship-gate thresholds. Source of truth: docs/AI_PAGE_TRANSLATION_VNEXT.md §5. Gating runs against NDJSON ledgers only; hand-written tables are not evidence. No pipeline change ships without Gates A-E.

gate0_placeholderProbe.$comment: Pre-freeze live probe: 3 providers x 2 pairs (ja->ko, ja->en) x n=5, fixture blocks with 2-6 placeholders in 64-block packets. Runs BEFORE the session layer is built; on fail, revise placeholder alphabet (candidate ⟦n⟧) and re-run.

gateA_offlineReplay.$comment: CI, free, every PR. >=6 of 12 fixture families + recorded provider replies.

gateB_placeholderProperties.$comment: CI, free. Generative round-trip + adversarial mangling. Ladder must terminate in repair|flatten|atomic-degrade; never throw, never write outside block, never blank interactive-element text, never loop.

gateC_liveQuality.$comment: n>=5 AB/BA, pre-ship + weekly. chrF refs generated once by strongest model, human spot-checked, committed.

fallbackRule.$comment: Pre-registered deadlock breaker: PASS if wordOrderProbes >= threshold AND chrF >= stable-0.5 on every pair.

gateD_latency.$comment: Live Chrome, 4G throttle, same harness. TTFP = first CAS commit.

gateE_tokens.$comment: Receipts-vs-receipts only. Stable baseline recorded ONCE in the same harness/snapshot/provider before comparison; the 155K heuristic is NOT a valid baseline.

gateF_humanSpotCheck.$comment: Bounded, once, before default flip. 3 pages x 2 pairs, 20 random blocks each, 1-4 adequacy/fluency, logged to ledger.

packetSizing.$comment: Output-token-derived caps. drain shrunk to small-packet regime (decode-bound latency, small packets win on tail + parallelism). Basis: .artifacts/vnext-gates/latency-gpt-5.6-luna-none.md (2026-07-14). outputTokenHeadroomFactor is the SIZING/feasibility reserve (1.25x est-out) and is DECOUPLED from the max_output actually sent — see maxOutputSend* below.

maxOutputSend.$comment: The max_output_tokens REQUESTED from the provider is decoupled from est-out sizing: max(3x est-out, 2048 floor), always capped DOWN by the provider/combined output ceiling (never raises the feasibility bar, never forces chunking). Prevents dense ja->ko decode from truncating at a tight limit and splitting into extra requests; costs no latency when the model stops early.

concurrencyAimd.$comment: Spec §2.3 — per (provider, apiKeyHash); cooldowns scoped per key, always recovering.

openai.$comment: cap raised 8->32; a real key sustained conc32/128 packets, 0x429. Basis: .artifacts/vnext-gates/latency-gpt-5.6-luna-none.md (2026-07-14, gpt-5.6-luna, reasoning:none).

hedging.$comment: Straggler tail-latency hedging. Mirrors AI_PAGE_HEDGE in common/scripts/ai_page_translation_limits.js. wall-clock == slowest packet; when an in-flight packet exceeds thresholdMs AND a slot is free AND no fresh work is queued, dispatch a SECOND concurrent request under a DISTINCT wire packetId (the background joins same-packetId in-flight calls, so a distinct id is required to force a genuinely new provider generation) and take whichever returns first. Basis: 福島県 (2154 strings, 147 packets, gpt-5.6-luna reasoning:none) is bimodal ~14s/~55s with identical request count/tokens/0-failed; 12s threshold (well above per-packet p90 ~8s) + idle-slot hedge collapses the ~40s slow mode. maxPerPacket 1 bounds cost/growth to at most one extra generation per packet. The loser's generation is still billed by the provider but its receipt is discarded by our ledger, so the banner may under-report by the loser's tokens.

estimator.$comment: Spec §4.1 — the ONE formula. All legacy formulas deleted.

outRatioSourceFloor.$comment: ja/zh SOURCE tokenizes densely -> high output-token expansion for every target. Floor supersedes lower legacy en pins (ja-en 1.6->1.8, zh-en 1.5->1.7) so packets are sized from realistic output and max_output no longer truncates.

scheduling.$comment: One-pass whole-document collection; no viewport/focus priority.
